description: Trigger evals for skills/airflow. Each query runs in a copy of fixtures/<context>. 'expected' is the one Airflow skill that should fire, or null for near-misses where no Airflow skill should fire. 'other_ok' lists non-Airflow repo skills that are a reasonable pick (informational only).
